text:
It was a busy day today! We started by checking that Canberra would be partly cloudy with a high of 24°C, and I confirmed your schedule for Standup, the Roadmap sync, and your 1:1 with Dev. On the work front, we added the need to get capacity numbers from Dev into your Roadmap Sync note.

For personal logistics, you had me set two important reminders: one for Thursday at 9:00 AM to call the physio about your next appointment, and another reminder for 4:45 PM today to pick up your parcel. You also asked about quick lunch ideas using halloumi and capsicum, and I provided a few wrap suggestions.

We also looked into the post office hours in Dickson, but since I couldn't find a reliable listing, you decided to check on your own way. Overall, despite tackling several tasks and appointments today, it was lovely that you were able to take a coffee outside after lunch when the sun came out!
